_meta.source: Original wording for this project (design document, section 6)
notes: Every system message is spoken by the Voice of the World: flat, neutral, brief.
Text in {braces} is filled in by code. Do not rename a placeholder without changing the call site.
Keys starting with debug_ are only reachable from the debug overlay.

lines.life_begin: A soul has settled. Vessel: {race}. Place: {region}.
lines.imprint_granted: The previous end left its mark. Granted: {resistance}.
lines.analysis_remembered: Analysis complete: {subject}. The soul already knew it.
lines.advisor_link_offer: Analysis is slow on its own. Linked to Parallel Processing it would take about a fiftieth of the time.
lines.advisor_link_done: Link established. Analysis now runs across parallel threads.
lines.advisor_link_declined: Understood. The link can be made later from the status sheet.
lines.advisor_threat_high: Advice: {name} far exceeds this body. Rank {rank}. Avoid it, or prepare first.
lines.advisor_threat_even: Advice: {name}, rank {rank}. Within this body's reach.
lines.advisor_low_health_potion: Health is critical. A potion is ready.
lines.advisor_staggered: Target staggered. Predation is likely to succeed now.
lines.advisor_water: Water can be stored in the Stomach. Hold devour while submerged.
lines.advisor_practice: Repetition is registering. Keep going and the technique will take shape.
lines.advisor_herb: Hipokute herb nearby. Devouring one allows analysis.
lines.rank_changed: Existence reassessed. Rank {old} is now rank {new}.
lines.death_imprint: The cause is inscribed on the soul: {resistance}.
lines.rebirth: The soul moves on. A new branch opens.
lines.data_fault: {count} content records could not be read. See the log.
lines.debug_broadcast: Test broadcast. All within range receive this.
lines.debug_advisor: Test reply. This is the advisor, not the Voice of the World.
